name: TJWA_TC_FSB_009 - [Boundary] Partner site links open safely in a new tab
fullName: TJWA_TC_FSB_009 - [Boundary] Partner site links open safely in a new tab
description:
Verify every partner site link opens in a new tab (target="_blank") with rel="noopener" set, so the sibling site cannot control the original tab.

Expected: Every partner link has target="_blank" and a rel attribute including "noopener".
